title: Top 10 Questions Before Booking a Limousine in OC
description: Discover the top 10 questions to ask before booking a limo in Anaheim & Orange County. Travel safe and stylish with 5 Star Limousine & Transportation Services.
h1: 1. What Types of Vehicles Do You Offer?

blocks.text: Booking a limousine for a special occasion — whether it’s a wedding, prom, corporate event, airport transfer, or night out — should always be a thoughtful process. blocks.text: 2. Is the Pricing Transparent and What’s Included?

One of the most important questions to ask is about pricing — and specifically what is included in the quoted rate. Some companies add hidden fees later for things like fuel, waiting time, or gratuity. Ask for a clear breakdown of costs so you’re not surprised when you receive the bill.
